warnings: This sheet packs many short interior beam segments (marks B1/B2/B3/B4 reused across several different segments, per the project's generic-mark convention already confirmed on this same sheet — e.g. B3 appears at both the west edge A1-B1 and the row-B edge B1-B2 with identical spec) into a visually compact area around the two bedrooms/bathrooms/dining zone. Perimeter beams (B3A, B5, B5A, B5B, B6, B6X) and the clearly-labelled column/slab positions are extracted with high confidence; the exact grid-cell assignment for the reused-mark interior segments (B1, B2, B3, B3X, B4, B4X, BX) was cross-checked against the architectural floor plan A-04's room layout and partition dimensions rather than isolated purely from this sheet's own tightly-packed labels, and is recorded at a reduced confidence_score (0.65-0.75) per affected element rather than left blank. A higher-zoom re-check against the source PDF is recommended if per-segment certainty is required.

Beam B2 (between the two ห้องน้ำ) lands on dummy grid '1'' (pos_m=2.30), added to the grid master from A-04's printed 2.30+1.70=4.00 m sub-dimension of the grid-1-to-2 bay — see หน้า00_gridline.json warnings.

BX is a level-transition (stepped/tapering) beam per its own detail on S-10 (หน้า33, 'ระดับพื้นภายใน' vs 'ระดับพื้นภายนอก') — used here at the row-C threshold between the interior floor (+0.50/+0.47) and the exterior/เฉลียง; B5B is a similarly tapering beam (0.60 to 0.27/0.33 deep per S-10) used at the col-4 edge between rows B and C.

SC1 (steel columns, ⌐-100x100x6.0mm, per the sheet's own หมายเหตุ) support the carport roof and sit directly above the C0 RC pedestals at the same D2/D4/E2/E4 grid points recorded on S-02 (หน้า25) — two different structural materials at the same plan position, kept as separate elements (steel column SC1 vs RC pedestal C0).
